notes.title: Speedollama v1.5.0 – Faster than ever!
notes.content:
Hey Speedsters!

We’re back with Speedollama v1.5.0, and this update is a game-changer—literally! We’ve completely revamped wall climbing, making movement smoother, faster, and more intuitive than ever before. No more clunky wall clings when all you want is pure, uninterrupted vertical speed.

But that’s not all! We’ve also enhanced PlayStation controller support, making explosions, gunfire, and all the insane action feel even better with controller vibrations and dynamic lighting. Oh, and of course, we fine-tuned some weapons and squashed a few bugs along the way!

Check out the full patch notes below!

[h2]Speedollama v1.5.0 – Patch Notes[/h2]

[h2]Major Gameplay Update: Wall Climbing Revamped![/h2]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked how players can climb walls. Wall Cling is no longer required for vertical movement! Now, as long as the player is colliding with a wall, they can jump indefinitely, allowing for seamless vertical progression.
[*] Wall Cling is still available for combat tactics and strategic use, but movement is now smoother and faster—perfectly suited for Speedollama’s insanely fast-paced gameplay!
[/list]

[h2]PlayStation Controller Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gamepad Vibration Added – Players using DualShock 4 and DualSense controllers will now feel the action in their hands! Explosions, gunfire, and high-speed movement now come with satisfying vibrations that bring the chaos to life.
[*] Dynamic Controller Light Colors – A small but stylish addition: your PlayStation controller will now illuminate with the character’s signature color:
[list]
[*] 🔴 Chris – Red
[*] 🟢 Arnold – Green
[*] 🔵 Lizzy – Blue
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay Balancing & Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapon Damage Tweaks – Adjusted damage values for certain weapons to increase combat satisfaction, especially for powerful weapons like:
[list]
[*] Rocket Launcher – More explosive impact
[*] Mega Missile – Higher devastation level
[/list]
[*] General Polish & Bug Fixes – Various minor bugs and tweaks have been addressed to enhance overall player experience and smooth out gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]Now’s the Best Time to Get Speedollama![/h2]
If you’ve had Speedollama sitting in your wishlist, now is the perfect time to grab it! With this update making movement smoother, action more satisfying, and controls more immersive, there’s never been a better moment to jump in.

And if this is your first time hearing about Speedollama, well—what are you waiting for? Add it to your wishlist or grab it right now! As a small indie team, we truly believe Speedollama deserves way more attention than it has received so far. Every purchase, every review, and even just spreading the word helps us tremendously. Indie games thrive on community support, so if you enjoy Speedollama, let your friends know about it!

Thanks for being part of this crazy, fast-paced, llama-fueled adventure. Your support means the world to us. Now, get back in the game and embrace the chaos!

See you on the battlefield, Speedsters!

Nicola

notes.title: Unleash the Alpaca-lypse! Speedollama is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
After months of development, [i]Speedollama[/i] is finally here! Get ready for intense, fast-paced action in this retro-inspired run and gun platformer, where llamas face off against evil alpacas in a quirky, action-packed showdown.

What to Expect:

[list]
[*] Vibrant pixel-art graphics with a nostalgic arcade feel
[*] High-speed gameplay with unlockable speed upgrades
[*] Procedurally generated levels full of chaotic fun
[*] Challenging bosses and hilarious enemies
[/list]

⚙️ Speedollama runs great on PC (Windows, MacOS, Linux), and it’s [b]fully optimized for Steam Deck![/b]

Thank you all for your patience and support. If you encounter any bugs or issues, please report them.

And don't forget to have a look at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2571500/discussions/0/4700161359561325445/]Developer's Starting Guide[/url] to get a few hints before you jump into the game!

Post your feedback here, and enjoy the game!

[previewyoutube=EYFWldXi1bo;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy gaming, and good luck against those alpacas! 💥
Yours, Nicola

notes.title: Speedollama is out on October 21!
notes.content:
Chaosmonger Studio Announces Release Date for Speedollama – A Quirky Retro-Inspired Platform Shooter for PC and Consoles 🦙, coming on Steam on October 21!

[i]If you think alpacas are cuddly, sweet animals, think again. In Speedollama, these wooly creatures have turned vicious, waging war on the world’s llamas. As a player, it’s your mission to take down the alpaca army and save the world from their furry domination.[/i]

Speedollama features vibrant pixel-art visuals that evoke the charm of retro arcades, while incorporating modern gameplay elements such as procedurally generated levels, chaotic humor, and gallons of pixelated blood. This highly entertaining, action-packed adventure promises to appeal to gamers of all ages.
Drawing inspiration from classic titles like Metal Slug and Turrican, as well as modern hits like Broforce, Mercenary Kings, and Pizza Tower, Speedollama delivers a nostalgic yet fresh gaming experience.

Here the date release announcement trailer:
[previewyoutube=EYFWldXi1bo;full][/previewyoutube]

WHAT THE DEVELOPER SAYS
"I know the indie game market is crowded, with countless platformers being released every month. Standing out in that jungle is no easy task. But I believe Speedollama brings something truly unique to the table—it's fast, quirky, packed with animated details, and, above all, incredibly fun to play. I'm excited to take on the challenge and see how players react to this bizarre and entertaining experience!"

STORYLINE
A wise old llama has enlisted a group of elite mercenaries for an almost impossible mission: to destroy the alpaca army that has waged a brutal war to exterminate the llamas and seize world domination. Equipped with a powerful tunneling machine, the llamas embark on a bizarre journey, burrowing through the earth, collecting funky substances, and battling the relentless alpaca forces along with their beastly allies.


So, please wishlist and share the game out there! As a mostly-solo indie game developer, I truly count on each of you! 🙏

Thanks!

Nicola
